title: Where the project stands
text: The four repositories have been public under the retinue-os organization since 2026-07-18: the framework, this chamber, a reference deployment, and the qlever-dir indexer, with a history scrubbed of personal data. CI runs the test suite on every push and pull request and was green on main on 2026-07-19 — the suite is narrow, concentrated on send-policy and contact-lookup rather than on the web gateway, which carries most of the risk. Nothing has been announced anywhere. There are no social accounts, 0 stars, 0 forks, and no issue, discussion or message from anyone outside the project. That is not a disappointing result, it is an untested one: nobody has been told. Creating the accounts is the owner's move and the exit from this phase. Until then the work is groundwork — auditing the project's public surfaces against what the code actually does, running the claims in positioning.md rather than reading them, and keeping this dashboard honest. This page is itself one of those surfaces, and it was audited for the first time on 2026-07-20.
